description: Paginated curated Valentine gift starters. On amazon.se and amazon.com items include /dp/ASIN buy links (separate curated catalogs per store); on other marketplaces catalogMode is search-ideas. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Search (search_gifts) remains primary discovery. OpenAPI: getCatalog.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED — curated ASINs produce /dp links on amazon.se and amazon.com (US); other marketplaces get romantic search deep-links.

name: get_catalog
title: Curated gift catalog
